== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Zakariel, also known as the [[Fox]], is a highly selfish individual who primarily acts when there is a direct personal benefit. She possesses the ability to flicker through existence, slide in and out of reality, and move behind a [[veil]] of light. This mobility allows her to dodge massive energy strikes and evade various armies. In combat, she is a lethal predator capable of killing [[Silverlords]] with her dagger and can strike targets from vast distances. While she has been seen hiding behind Ozriel, she is also a capable combatant who has engaged in raids to collect valuables during [[Vroshir]] assaults. Though she may appear as a young girl, she has expressed a strong dislike for being called by the nickname Zak. Her motivations are driven by a desire to get close to true power, and she has expressed deep distrust toward others, specifically accusing individuals of inevitable betrayal.}}
